selection: 18 recent papers, datasets, releases and company announcements; source dates retained

items.title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
items.focus: Batch-CDF token reweighting; noisy preference labels
items.finding: Reported robustness gains; conditional gradient-bias bound
items.caveat: Small-batch sensitivity; sufficient theory assumptions; multi-turn extension untested
items.read_scope: Submission history, methods and limitations; code not executed; results not reproduced

items.title: VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
items.focus: Visual-evidence masking; multilingual DPO; object hallucination
items.finding: Reported POPE/MME improvements in Chinese, French, Hindi
items.caveat: English-centric transfer; Hindi required English-pair mixing
items.read_scope: Submission history, methods and limitations; code not executed; results not reproduced

items.title: PrivacyPR: Real-world privacy fixes for code-review evaluation
items.focus: 4,131 merged pull requests from 1,469 repositories; privacy-review evaluation
items.finding: On a 200-PR subset, privacy-specific prompts raised two agents' defect detection from 42–51% to 88–91%; false positives remained 11–15%
items.caveat: Small evaluation subset; both annotators endorsed 72% of automated GDPR-principle labels
items.read_scope: Abstract and submission history; results not reproduced

items.title: Mercor announces $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation
items.focus: Financing for human-expert data, evaluations and enterprise training environments
items.finding: $750M Series D; $20B valuation; employee tender included
items.caveat: Primary-versus-secondary capital split undisclosed; funding and valuation are not revenue
items.read_scope: Dated company announcement; reported outcomes not independently reproduced

items.title: FlinkEval: Synthetic data for streaming-SQL evaluation
items.focus: 3,903 question–SQL pairs across 45 domains; streaming semantics
items.finding: Execution-grounded generation and repair on Confluent Cloud Flink; paired technical and business-language requests
items.caveat: Single deployment; five-model study excluded 115 windowing cases affected by an engine defect; 81 background DML cases not executable, scored by judged SQL quality
items.read_scope: Primary paper / release and stated limitations; results not reproduced

items.title: Scale and Singapore's IMDA introduce SG-LegalClarify
items.focus: Whether models gather missing facts before applying Singapore law
items.finding: 19 models; 1,860 scenarios; 10 legal domains; best web-enabled model satisfied 77.8% of mandatory criteria
items.caveat: Reported criterion-satisfaction scores are not overall legal accuracy; jurisdiction-specific and partly AI-judged
items.read_scope: Dated company announcement; reported outcomes not independently reproduced

items.title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
items.focus: Predicted gaze features; asymmetric spatial redistribution; reward modeling
items.finding: Higher preference-prediction accuracy than fixation-centered baselines
items.caveat: English-only experiments; synthetic gaze; no downstream policy-alignment test
items.read_scope: Submission history, methods and limitations; code not executed; results not reproduced

items.title: Nemotron-PII-Japan: Annotated synthetic Japanese business documents
items.focus: 100,000 synthetic documents; 43 document types; 56 PII categories
items.finding: 810,703 character-span annotations generated from predetermined values and finalized text
items.caveat: Annotations are not exhaustive; no fixed public train/test split
items.date_basis: Announcement 9 Nov; dataset card release date 10 Nov 2026
items.read_scope: Primary paper / release and stated limitations; results not reproduced

items.title: Labelbox and Wipro partner on RL environments and managed enterprise agents
items.focus: Enterprise distribution and implementation for RL environments, reviewed agent work and ongoing evaluation
items.finding: Wipro implementation support; Horizon and Recursion collaboration; Wipro Ventures participated in the recent Series E
items.caveat: No named customer outcomes, deployment counts or measured production gains disclosed
items.read_scope: Dated company announcement; reported outcomes not independently reproduced

items.title: MotionGraphicsBench: Programmatic checks for generated animations
items.focus: 100 expert-curated tasks; animate supplied SVG elements
items.finding: Deterministic verifiers agreed with humans on 93.3% of 180 balanced held-out animations (90 approvals, 90 rejections), versus 83.3% for the VLM baseline
items.caveat: Narrow SVG motion-editing task; pass/fail measures instruction compliance rather than aesthetic quality
items.date_basis: arXiv v1 submission (UTC); release article 10 Nov 2026
items.read_scope: Primary paper / release and stated limitations; results not reproduced

items.title: AERO: Adaptive Ensemble-Disagreement Routing for Oracle Feedback in Sample-Efficient Online RLHF
items.focus: Ensemble-disagreement routing; oracle-query efficiency; online DPO
items.finding: Reported competitive alignment with fewer oracle queries in 1B-to-8B experiments
items.caveat: Deterministic reward-model oracle; no real human-feedback evaluation
items.read_scope: Submission history, methods and limitations; code not executed; results not reproduced

items.title: Shaping Useful Noise: An energy-distribution audit for synthetic images
items.focus: Energy-Level Distribution Distance; likelihood-profile comparison of real and synthetic images
items.finding: Across nine DINO pretraining sources, downstream linear-accuracy prediction MAE was 0.82 percentage points versus 0.91 for FID
items.caveat: Curation intervention reports frozen-feature proxies; matched pretraining remains future work
items.read_scope: Primary paper / release and stated limitations; results not reproduced

items.title: Turing describes turning connected company archives into RL benchmarks
items.focus: Connected operational records as source material for RL environments and evaluations
items.finding: Three-part benchmark design: working company simulation, work-derived tasks and automated outcome checks
items.caveat: Program explanation; no new customer, dataset size, benchmark score or privacy audit disclosed
items.date_basis: Program explanation published 11 Nov; launch date unspecified
items.read_scope: Dated company announcement; reported outcomes not independently reproduced

items.title: OmniSynth: Stress-testing synthetic-health-data quality metrics
items.focus: Meta-evaluation of fidelity, missingness, utility and privacy metrics
items.finding: Two health datasets; scores generally degraded monotonically; three of four missingness metrics captured induced patterns
items.caveat: Some classifier metrics were unstable; utility stress tests and fairness metrics remain incomplete
items.read_scope: Primary paper / release and stated limitations; results not reproduced

items.title: Surge reports targeted RL gains for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
items.focus: Expert-designed tasks and reward signals for specialized open-model post-training
items.finding: Four separate RL checkpoints; reported improvements on all 12 evaluated benchmarks
items.caveat: Company experiment; gains do not describe one combined model; published frontier-model comparisons use differing settings
items.date_basis: Visible publication date / JSON-LD; hidden 12 Nov date excluded
items.read_scope: Dated company announcement; reported outcomes not independently reproduced

items.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
items.focus: State-conditioned DPO; shorter verified reasoning continuations
items.finding: Reported completion-length reductions with maintained/improved mathematics and code accuracy
items.caveat: Stronger-judge data filtering; verifiable-task evidence; release availability unverified
items.read_scope: Submission history, methods and limitations; code not executed; results not reproduced

items.title: Toloka joins Fireworks' Frontier Ecosystem
items.focus: Connecting expert data creation, model post-training and specialized evaluation
items.finding: Frontier Ecosystem membership; Enterprise Tool-Use Leaderboard contribution to the Specialized Intelligence Index
items.caveat: Integration and improvement claims are promotional; no controlled customer outcome is reported
items.read_scope: Dated company announcement; reported outcomes not independently reproduced

items.title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
items.focus: Masked diffusion post-training; full-block likelihood estimation
items.finding: Unbiased estimator; average +12.79 accuracy points against random block sampling on five benchmarks
items.caveat: Adjacent post-training; PPO/DPO applications untested; one 8B architecture; parallel-memory cost
items.read_scope: Submission history, methods and limitations; code not executed; results not reproduced
